Glasstual

Support

Need help connecting, moving your settings, or reporting a bug? Contact the Glasstual developer directly.

Contact

Email hello@vakesz.com for support. You can also open a GitHub issue for a public bug report or feature request.

Include your macOS and Glasstual versions, what you expected, what happened, and steps to reproduce the issue. Please remove passwords, private messages, and personal data from screenshots or logs before sharing them.

Requirements

Glasstual runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 26 or later. You need access to an IRC server to chat. Some networks require their own account or registration; Glasstual does not provide an IRC account.

Unwanted Messages

Use Mute User or Add Ignore from a member's menu to limit messages you see. IRC networks set their own conduct rules and handle reports about their users; contact the network's operators to report abuse. For help using Glasstual's controls, email hello@vakesz.com.
